{{Top|leg}}
{{Image}}
'''Advanced cluster missiles''' were improved versions of the [[Cluster missile/Legends|cluster missile]] weapons system, boasting an improved exposive potency. They can be fired in groups of six.
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
Shortly after the destruction of the Echo Base shield generator, Luke, after killing a snowtrooper and manning the snowtrooper's tripod gun to fend off Imperial forces, fired on an AT-ST container and destroyed it. He then recovered the case of advanced cluster missiles that were within the destroyed container.
{{Endgame}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
During [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] infiltration and [[Battle near the Maw|liberation]] of the Maw Imperial Prison Facility, Rogue Leader Wedge Antilles, dropped various proton bombs from his BTL Y-wing starfighter on an environmental dome, and then procured some advanced cluster missiles amongst the rubble.
{{Endgame}}
